test_title: PYST 25: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

10, 15, 25, 45, 85, ?
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

**The difference between the numbers is double of the previous difference.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e79255588d91a052699f1197cf1f0be33b5d780a5e2876f1a1eaabde43279a9.png] 

So, **165 will complete the series.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
